## Wallpapers

Drawn from scratch by `pkgs/wallpapers/generate.py` in the color scheme's colors, so any scheme gets a matching wallpaper. Pick one with `gentleOS.theme.wallpaper` (see [Customizing Your Theme](../README.md#customizing-your-theme)).
